blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `cancelBeginOrderClaimValidationStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This step validates that the requested claim can be canceled by checking that it's not canceled,
its order isn't canceled, and it hasn't been confirmed. If not valid, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order, order claim, and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::

children.description: The data to validate the cancelation of a requested order claim.
